name: strad-bundle-host
description: The streamable-HTTP host for strad's single collapsed bundle: 13 MCP servers, one process, one Chromium.

comments.deps: Deliberately tiny. The 13 servers are NOT dependencies of this package — each lives in its own tree under /app/trees with its own node_modules, and this host imports the built files by path (see src/trees.ts). The only heavy dep here is Playwright, because the host owns the ONE Chromium that good-eggs, fetchpet and pointsyeah share.
comments.playwright: Pinned to 1.61.1: the exact version whose Chromium (rev 1228) ships in the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble base image, so nothing downloads a browser at build time. The three browser servers pin the same version — a shared Browser object across trees requires it.
